decisions.reason: The source specifies the raised base and cup clearance without changing the spouts' geometry, orientation, construction, or beverage-quality constraints.

The accepted custom-fabricated base may require additional materials or a BOM revision, but the evidence does not establish whether this structural fabrication belongs in the component-selection BOM or changes the prior no-additional-components decision.
The raised-base dimensions and sourcing decision do not alter the whisk selection, attachment, positioning, removal, or bowl compatibility.
The existing same-message Event captures the platform dimensions and fit but omits that the newly specified raised mixer base is to be custom-fabricated.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: This is the idea. I want the base to be five and a half inches tall so that our 12oz cups fit under the spouts. I want the machine to fit and sit on top of it perfectly. Edge to edge.

value_updates.mixer_fit: perfect edge-to-edge fit on top of the platform

decisions.reason: Providing clearance beneath the spouts does not change the valve mechanism, flow behavior, dispensing sequence, or gravity-based dispensing policy.
The base height and fit do not modify the requirement for splash-free mixing or its high-speed mitigation options.
The source does not change the machine name, placard wording, placement, viewing sides, or branding scope.
The separate raised platform does not change bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or clearance from the whisk and motor assembly.
The source specifies external cup clearance and platform fit without altering the liquid-containment or leak-prevention requirements.
The raised-base decision does not affect the required mixing texture, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The platform design does not change how the spout must be removed, flushed, or cleaned.
An edge-to-edge raised platform remains compatible with the existing DJ-turntable visual identity, and the source establishes no change to that identity.
